purpose: Teach: 腰痛/謝っ/微笑/寝よ/ほのか/凄かっ/冬場/軽やか

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、腰痛で、運動会、来られないかも。
lines.en: Mom, Dad — his back is really hurting. He might not be able to come to sports day.
lines.style: Hesitant onset. Quiet, careful tone — worried about upsetting her. Slow delivery. Trails off slightly at the end, like he's checking her face as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 明日、お友達に、ちゃんと謝っておいてね。
lines.en: Tomorrow, make sure you apologize to your friend properly, okay?
lines.style: Steady, gentle. No edge — just direct kindness. Slight maternal warmth on the reassurance. Short, clear phrasing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママの微笑、温かいんだ。
lines.en: Your smile is so warm, Mom.
lines.style: Small, genuine wonder in the voice. Quiet observation rather than performance. Soft, sincere — he's noticing something true in this moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: もう、寝ようかね、いい子だね。
lines.en: Come on, let's get you to bed. You're a good child.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate closing. No urgency. Slight sing-song lilt on 'good child' — the kind of phrase a mother uses that kids remember. Quiet fadeout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お風呂、ほのかな桜の香りがしたよ。
lines.en: The bath smelled faintly of cherry blossoms.
lines.style: Small, genuine delight. Soft but alert — he's noticing sensory details. Light pace. Quiet appreciation, not exclamation.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 昨日の花火、凄かったわね。
lines.en: Yesterday's fireworks were really something, weren't they?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wistful. Warm tone but a bit distant — remembering. Gentle lilt on the question tag. No hurry.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Winter's too cold. I'm not good with snow.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with a thread of mild complaint. Light, self-aware humor underneath — not quite resigned. Steady pace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 軽やかな足取りで、明日、頑張ろうね。
lines.en: Light on your feet tomorrow — let's do our best together.
lines.style: Encouraging but not pushy. Warm, confident tone. Slight lift on 'our best' — including him, not pushing him alone. Gentle close.
